name: Taiga Building Products Ltd.
summary: Taiga Building Products Ltd. operates as a wholesale distributor of building products in Canada and the United States. The company offers dimension lumber; panel products, including plywood, particle board, and oriented strand board products; and allied and treated products, such as roofing materials, moldings, composite decking, and polyethylene sheeting products, batt and foam insulation, flooring, and engineered and treated wood products.
